top_signals.title: China Sells Debut Green Bond in Canada Amid Robust Demand
top_signals.summary: China priced its debut yuan-denominated green bond sale in Canada after attracting robust demand, expanding its offshore debt footprint to finance sustainable projects as ties between the two nations warm.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stained Glass and Sacred Spaces: Symbolism Abounds in Ukrainian Media
top_signals.summary:
Welcome to The Ukraine Compass, a weekly digest of Ukrainian commentary and analysis from across the political spectrum, only for War on the Rocks members. Each week, we bring you a curated selection of articles from Ukrainian media offering insight into how Ukrainians themselves debate the issues shaping their country.Western coverage often narrows the view to the battlefield — these pieces widen it, revealing the texture of daily life, politics, and public argument in a nation at war. The perspectives gathered here are varied, candid, and often surprising, together forming a more complete picture of Ukraine as it really is.Frontline

top_signals.title: US Natural Gas Surges Most in Six Weeks, Triggers Short Squeeze
top_signals.summary: US natural gas futures rose by as much as 8%, the most since September, after forecasts for cooler weather across the Atlantic seaboard gave prices an upward push and forced hedge funds to unwind bearish bets.
